BLE 广播地址 · 优先显示最可能的 Pro2 · 点击地址尝试连接: BLE address · Most likely Pro2 first · Click an address to connect
上 X 右 A 下 B 左 Y: Up X　Right A　Down B　Left Y
两种连接各存一份，自动切换。: Each connection keeps its own copy; switches automatically.
仅重启所选设备，不改蓝牙参数、驱动或配对。: Only restarts the selected device; keeps Bluetooth settings, driver and pairing.
修改前请退出游戏。只添加独立图标补丁，不覆盖原游戏包；游戏更新后需重新检查兼容性: Quit the game before patching. This only adds a separate glyph patch and never overwrites the game package; re-check compatibility after a game update.
先按主键，再按搭子键；单独按立即出键。: Press the main key first, then the partner key; pressing it alone fires immediately.
先让第一只进入游戏，再逐只配对、连接。每只可单独选模式，改选后点“应用模式”；首: Let the first controller enter the game, then pair and connect the others one by one. Each can use its own mode; after changing it click Apply mode. The home-page mode only controls controller 1.
包含系统、驱动及每组蓝牙预设结果。直接复制即可；查看不会重新测试。: Includes system, driver and per-preset Bluetooth results. Copy directly; viewing does not re-run the tests.
只调灵敏度，不改方向；不影响右摇杆映射。: Adjusts sensitivity only, not direction; the right-stick mapping is unaffected.
可选择游戏根目录；支持不同盘符、中文路径和多个 Steam 库。: Pick the game root folder; different drives, non-ASCII paths and multiple Steam libraries are supported.
右摇杆映射在「陀螺仪与震动」页。: The right-stick mapping lives on the Gyro and Rumble page.
同键还绑了双击或长按，会稍慢一点。: This key also has a double-tap or hold action, so it responds slightly slower.
含通用提示、菜单／教程动作表、文本内嵌按键及物品／装备选中提示。整张手柄示意图和: Covers generic prompts, menu and tutorial action rows, inline key hints and item or equipment prompts. The controller diagram and touchpad gestures are kept.
将停止助手的手柄连接和游戏输出。所选适配器上的蓝牙耳机、鼠标、键盘等也会断开；请: Stops the controller connection and game output. Bluetooth headsets, mice and keyboards on the selected adapter also disconnect; save your game first.
影之刃零 · 保持 PS5 模式，按实际位置显示 Pro2 键名。: Phantom Blade Zero · Stay in PS5 mode; Pro2 key names follow their real positions.
推到边缘时的最大行程，决定满舵与死区边界: Full travel at the edge; sets full-deflection and deadzone bounds
新建会复制当前这套的按键。双击上方的配置名就能改名；列表点名字切换，× 删除（至: New copies the current key set. Double-click a name above to rename; click a name to switch, × to delete (at least one profile stays).
松开摇杆后的回中偏移，静置手柄后自动复核: Offset after release; re-checked automatically once the controller rests
校准一次自动存到配置页，下次连接直接复用: Calibrate once; it is saved to the profile and reused on the next connection
模式可离线保存，各槽位可混用。应用模式只重建本槽位的虚拟输出，保留实体蓝牙和其他: Modes are saved offline and can be mixed across slots. Applying a mode rebuilds only that slot's virtual output and keeps the physical Bluetooth link and the other slots. Real concurrency and rate depend on actual testing.
满速为陀螺仪打满时对应的角速度，数值越大越灵敏；下压倍率只作用于向下转动；轻按手: Full speed is the angular rate that saturates the gyro; higher means more sensitive. The downward scale only affects downward motion. Tap C on the controller to toggle the gyro right-stick mapping.
点「捕获」后按键盘上的键: Click Capture, then press a key
算法字段 scale_pitch · 范围 0.1–5.0，俯仰轴输出缩放: Field scale_pitch · range 0.1–5.0, pitch output scale
算法字段 scale_pitch_down · 范围 0.1–5.0，只作用于向: Field scale_pitch_down · range 0.1–5.0, downward motion only
算法字段 scale_yaw · 范围 0.1–5.0，偏航轴输出缩放: Field scale_yaw · range 0.1–5.0, yaw output scale
自动查找后检测游戏版本。: Detects the game version after auto-detect.
越小越跟手；过小会有不可避免的漂移。: Lower feels more responsive; too low causes unavoidable drift.
需要管理员授权。重启后请唤醒 Pro2 并重新连接；此操作不保证提高回报率。: Requires admin approval. Wake the Pro2 and reconnect afterwards; this does not guarantee a higher polling rate.
已连接，等待进入游戏。: Connected, waiting to enter the game.
已启用，等待进入游戏。: Enabled, waiting to enter the game.
FD2 或 Parsed 明显低于原生／已保留预设，恢复此前最佳路线。: FD2 or parsed rate is clearly below the native or retained route; restoring the previous best route.
前后窗口时长不匹配，不保留该预设。: The two measurement windows differ in length; the preset is not retained.
原生输入已达标，保持原生连接。: Native input already meets the standard; staying on the native connection.
已记录当前最佳低速路线，不承诺最低 66Hz。: Best low-rate route recorded; no minimum of 66Hz is promised.
最终复核发生降速或明显卡顿，不能宣称稳定达标。: The final check dropped in rate or showed clear stalls; stable compliance cannot be claimed.
最终完整窗口无效，不能宣称稳定达标。: The final full window is invalid; stable compliance cannot be claimed.
最终窗口仍在 60Hz 以上且优于原连接，保留可游玩预设；未达到 125Hz 标: The final window stays above 60Hz and beats the original connection; keeping the playable preset, below the 125Hz standard.
最终窗口可游玩，但没有达到 125Hz 标准。: The final window is playable but below the 125Hz standard.
最终窗口真实输入达到 125Hz 标准，保留该预设；后续仍持续监测。: The final window reaches the 125Hz standard; the preset is kept and monitoring continues.
没有达到可确认的频率或稳定性改善，恢复此前最佳路线。: No confirmable rate or stability improvement; restoring the previous best route.
真实 FD2 / Parsed 已达 125Hz 标准，立即采用该预设。: Real FD2 / parsed input reaches the 125Hz standard; adopting this preset now.
真实输入明显改善，暂保留；继续尝试剩余预设，不把部分改善标为达标。: Real input improved clearly; keeping it for now and trying the remaining presets. A partial improvement is not called compliance.
真实输入未优于已保留路线，恢复此前最佳路线。: Real input did not beat the retained route; restoring the previous best route.
连接、输入新鲜度、完整窗口或解析完整性未通过，不保留该预设。: Connection, input freshness, full window or parse integrity did not pass; the preset is not retained.
通知间隙明显恶化，不以较高平均频率掩盖卡顿。: Notification gaps got clearly worse; a higher average rate does not hide stalls.
频率处于测量容差内，但通知间隙明显改善，暂保留较稳定路线。: The rate is within measurement tolerance, but notification gaps improved clearly; keeping the steadier route for now.
登录 Windows 后自动启动，直接收进托盘，不弹主界面: Start with Windows and go straight to the tray, without a main window
关闭窗口即退出；最小化只收进托盘。托盘图标左键打开主界面，右键可导出连接诊断或退: Closing the window quits; minimizing only hides it to the tray. Left-click the tray icon to open the main window, right-click to export diagnostics or quit.
